HM: Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Wall Hook
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-hm-ligature-resistant-hookmax-wall-hook
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/facility-maintenance/ligature-resistant-hooks/hookmax/
Spec sheet: HM
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Wall Hook – HM
Current H1: Cortech Ligature Resistant HookMax Wall Hook - HM
Subtitle: Flexible Wall Hook That Bends and Releases at a Maximum 10 lb Load, Sold in Packs of 5
Current subtitle: Cortech USA HM Hookmax Anti-Ligature Hooks
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Wall Hook holds clothing and towels in resident rooms, bathrooms, and common areas of behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities. It releases at a maximum load of 10 lbs: the hook bends, the item or ligature slides off, and the hook returns to its shape.
The hook has a PC/ABS core and a flexible TPU outer piece that helps prevent injury, and it releases in all directions, so it can be placed close to furniture and doors. It comes in five colors and is sold in packs of 5.
Material: PC/ABS core with a flexible TPU outer piece
Dimensions: 1.24”W×0.85”D×2.05”H
Release: Releases in all directions (360°) at a maximum 10 lb load, then returns to its shape
Testing: Load release tests with a string, shoelace, or rope made from bedsheets release at a maximum of 10 lbs
Mounting: Mount to a flat surface so the hook fits tightly against the wall
Care: Resistant to alcohol and most detergents
Colors: White, Gray, Black, Beige, or Magenta
Packaging: Sold in packs of 5. Price is per pack
Warranty: 3-year warranty for the intended use; full warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: Designed and produced in Sweden
Available Models and Options
HookMax, 5 Pack: HMWH - White, HMGY - Gray, HMBK - Black, HMBE - Beige, HMMG - Magenta
[H2] Applications
The HookMax suits rooms where residents need a place to hang clothing and towels without creating a ligature point.
Typical applications include:
Resident rooms and bathrooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Cells and common areas in correctional facilities and jails
Residential treatment centers and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Hardware for Behavioral Health Care Facilities and Prison & Detention Hardware & Equipment collections for more ligature resistant hardware.
[H2] About Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Hooks
Cortech HookMax hooks hold clothing and towels, but bend and release when extra force is applied, so a ligature slides off. After release, the hook returns to its shape and keeps working. They suit resident rooms, bathrooms, and common areas in behavioral healthcare and correctional facilities.
The HookMax line includes:
HookMax: Releases at a maximum 10 lb load
HookMax+: Releases at a maximum 20 lb load
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (62 characters): Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Wall Hook - HM at Anchortex
Meta description (154 characters): Shop the Cortech HookMax ligature resistant wall hook. A flexible hook that bends and releases at a maximum 10 lb load so ligatures slide off. Packs of 5.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech HookMax Ligature Resistant Hooks" is a new section for the HookMax and HookMax+ pages. It is the same on both pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Ligature Resistant HookMax. I put "HookMax" first and used "Wall Hook," to match the HookMax+ page.
Colors: your variant is "HM - Pack of 5" with no color option. Cortech sells the HookMax in five colors (HMWH White, HMGY Gray, HMBK Black, HMBE Beige, HMMG Magenta). How do customers choose a color? Would you like color variants?
Weight and size: your variant is set to 5 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight. The dimensions are for one hook.
Country of manufacture: the Cortech spec sheet says the HookMax is designed and produced in Sweden, so I added it.
Mounting: the Cortech spec sheet says to mount the hook to a flat surface for a tight fit, but does not say how it attaches (screws or adhesive), so I left that out.
I left out "Patent pending," to match the other pages.
Product images: the page has one image. I did not find other HookMax photos on the Cortech website.
